messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: kv_writeback_errors spike > 300/min on prod-nginx-cluster — pager triggered to @oncall
Asha: oncall here, seeing the pager. joining triage now. TL;DR: surge of writeback errors from kv-proxy, likely noisy log signature. no obvious user-visible errors yet :eyes:
Riley: ETA to root cause? any customer impact metrics?
Asha: current 5m error-rate 320/min, 99th p99 latency steady. No increase in 502s to customers in the app logs. Putting incident tag.
Asha: quick check: error messages look like repeated transient EPIPE from background flush worker — lots of identical stack traces. suspect alert signature too broad.
Tom: copying the raw snippet I’m seeing in logs: ```level=error component=kv proxy writeback failed addr=10.2.3.8 err="write tcp 10.0.0.5:4500: write: connection reset by peer" stack=...```
Janelle: agree looks like connection resets from an upstream flapping node. But many duplicates from same host, should be deduped.
Asha: mitigation plan: 1) suppress noisy signature for now (temporary), 2) narrow regex to only match when err contains "connection reset by peer" AND upstream host not in maintenance list, 3) create dashboard panel to track unique hosts causing errors, 4) follow up with infra to check kv-proxy host.
Riley: +1. How do we suppress quickly? can you push a live rule edit?
Asha: I have permissions. Patching alert rule: set rule.suppression=true with 15m window for this signature. Will post diff.
Asha: Patch diff (live edit): ```# old
query: log_type="kv" | match /writeback/ | count_over_time(5m) > 100
# new
query: log_type="kv" | match /writeback/ | regex "%ERROR%connection reset by peer%" | exclude host =~ /kv-proxy-maint/ | count_over_time(5m) > 300
suppression: {reason: "temporary noisy signature", window: "15m"}
```
Victor: tagging infra on the host list, there's a k8s node with OOMs earlier; could be related.
Tom: I'm going to create a quick dashboard panel in Grafana: panel showing errored hosts and rate. Will push to the incident dashboard and link here.
Tom: dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/incident/kv-writeback?orgId=1
Janelle: created a follow-up ticket to implement a permanent signature that dedups by host and incorporates http status codes: RDW-3245. Assigning to eng-runtime.
Asha: suppression applied at 1719992700 — will monitor. If error-rate drops on pager we can quiet it and then revert suppression later after proper signature rollout.
incident-bot: NOTE: oncall handoff scheduled in 2h (Asha -> Tom). Add "handoff" when resolved.
Riley: customer impact: ran a quick query against frontend 5m error logs — no increase in 5xx. Customer-facing SLA unaffected. Marking impact=low.
Victor: infra found a flapping NIC on node ip 10.2.3.8, restarted kube-proxy on that node at 1719993000.
Asha: after restart we see per-host duplicates drop from 230/min to ~10/min for that host. overall cluster error-rate dropped to 45/min. Good signal that restart helped.
Tom: lifting suppression? recommend keep suppression for another 30m then revert and deploy refined signature.
Asha: agreed. I'll schedule the refined rule rollout. Proposed refined regex (for follow-up): ```regex: "write tcp .*:.*: write: (connection reset by peer|broken pipe)" dedupe_by: host exclude_list: ["kv-proxy-maint"] threshold: 80m5```
Janelle: creating change PR for alert-rule repo: https://git.internal/redwood/alert-rules/pull/412 — includes dedupe_by host and threshold tuning.
Tom: I'll own monitoring post-handoff. Handoff at 1720000000. Tom will watch for any regression and revert if needed.
Asha: leaving notes in incident runbook and adding timeline to the ticket. Thank you team.
Victor: postmortem task: verify node NIC firmware and schedule maintenance if flaky. Assigned RDW-3246.
incident-bot: Incident closed for paging at 1719995900 (pager quiet for 45m).
Asha: short post-incident notes: root cause likely upstream flaky NIC causing repeated write resets; mitigation was node restart + temporary suppression + refined alert signature rollout. No customer impact. Actions: 1) merge PR 412 and deploy refined rule, 2) infra to remediate hardware, 3) add dashboard panel for unique-host error counts.
Tom: I'll merge the PR after CI: expected deploy window tonight 0200 UTC. I'll also add an alert owner and link runbook.
Janelle: leaving ✅ — closing incident thread. Follow-ups in RDW-3245 and RDW-3246.
